worn.definition: a. affected by wear; damaged by long use
worn.translation:
a. 用旧的, 穿旧的
wear的过去分词

worn to a thread.translation: 穿旧的,穿烂的,破烂不堪

worn-down.translation: adj. 用坏的，穿坏的; 用旧的，穿旧的; 疲惫不堪的

worn-out.definition:
s used until no longer useful
s drained of energy or effectiveness; extremely tired; completely exhausted
worn-out.translation: a. 磨破的, 磨损的, 穿旧的, 疲惫不堪的
